title: 学生社团安全守则：欺凌、集体活动、饮酒与出行（国内版）
source_doc: course/RSO Training Series/05_Spring 2016 RSO Training Module 2.md
author_source: project/RSO Training Series/05_Spring 2016 RSO Training Module 2（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 本课讲社团必知的校规
points.K7: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
points.K8: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
points.K11: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
points.K15: 不同观点分区，配合查验
points.K18: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
points.K23: 驾驶审批材料要提前交
points.K24: 罚单自己担，保险看手续
points.S8: 社团借用实验室，先准入

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园社团活动中心门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the entrance of a campus student activity center with blank club banners and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲学生社团的安全守则。
overlay: 学生社团安全守则：欺凌、集体活动、饮酒与出行

shots.scene: 四个图标：举起的手掌、人群、酒杯、汽车
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a raised open palm, a small crowd, a wine glass, and a car. No people.
shots.narration: 欺凌、集体活动、饮酒、出行，一个个讲。

shots.scene: 阿杰在社团活动室兴奋地对着空白计划板比划
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gestures excitedly at a blank planning board in a student club room.
shots.narration: 阿杰当上社长，忙着策划迎新。

shots.scene: 空白计划板上画着啤酒杯、深夜月亮、汽车三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank planning board with three doodled icons: a beer mug, a night moon, and a car. No people.
shots.narration: 他想搞“入社考验”，再聚餐、连夜自驾。

shots.scene: 小研皱眉，把一本空白手册放到他面前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns and places a blank handbook in front of the young male student.
shots.narration: 老社员小研说：这几样，都踩到红线了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 社团活动要热闹，更要守规矩。

shots.section_title: 本课讲社团必知的校规
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白校规手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a thick blank rule book on a desk.
shots.narration: 社团负责人，先要懂这几条校规。
overlay: 本课讲社团必知的校规

shots.section_title: 本课讲社团必知的校规
shots.scene: 五个图标排成一行：手掌、人群、酒杯、汽车、对话气泡
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a raised palm, a crowd, a wine glass, a car, and a speech bubble with a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 管好活动，也就护好了每个成员。

shots.scene: 一群学生围着一名新生，新生低头站着
shots.prompt_en: A group of students surround a new student who stands with head down in a club room. Simple cartoon, no faces in focus.
shots.narration: 要求新人做某事才能入会，

shots.scene: 校园和校外街道两个图标，中间一个等号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a campus building and an off-campus street, with an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 不管在校内还是校外，

shots.scene: 一个受伤的绷带图标和一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A bandage icon and a yellow warning triangle side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 只要会伤人或可能伤人，就是欺凌。

shots.scene: 新生举手说“我愿意”，手势被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon icon of a raised hand saying yes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: “是他自己愿意的”，不能当借口。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头摆手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head and waves its paw firmly.
shots.narration: 新人往往不敢说不，同意不等于没伤害。

shots.scene: 三个图标：疲惫的小人、酒瓶、惊吓的闪电，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: an exhausted stick figure, a liquor bottle, and a startling lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 折腾到筋疲力尽、逼着喝酒、故意惊吓，

shots.scene: 三个图标：木板、悬崖、哭脸面具，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: a wooden paddle, a cliff edge, and a crying mask. No people.
shots.narration: 体罚、危险挑战、羞辱人的游戏，

shots.scene: 三个图标：被拿走的背包、受伤的手臂、被推的小人，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: a taken backpack, an injured arm, and a pushed stick figure. No people.
shots.narration: 拿别人东西、动手伤人、逼人违规，

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜看一长串图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks through a magnifying glass at a long row of small crossed-out icons.
shots.narration: 这些只是例子，不止这些。

shots.scene: 空白处分决定书和一枚印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank disciplinary notice with a stamp beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 搞欺凌的学生和社团，要受纪律处分。

shots.scene: 老师、研究人员图标同样站在天平前
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a teacher and a researcher standing in front of a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 教职工、访问人员参与，也一样处理。

shots.scene: 法槌图标
shots.prompt_en: A judge's gavel icon on a blank book. No people.
shots.narration: 情节严重的，还要承担法律责任。

shots.scene: 阿杰犹豫地看着手机，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks hesitantly at a phone with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 看到或听说欺凌，别装作不知道。

shots.scene: 三个图标：学院楼、盾牌、电话
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a college building, a shield, and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 找辅导员、学院、学生工作部门或保卫处。

shots.scene: 一个信封图标投进带锁的信箱
shots.prompt_en: An envelope icon dropping into a locked mailbox, with a mask icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 不方便露面，也可以匿名反映。

shots.section_title: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
shots.scene: 欣欣站在图书馆前，背后是灯泡和书本图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a library with light bulb and book icons floating above.
shots.narration: 大学靠研究和教学，发现和传播知识。
overlay: 大学需要交流，表达要负责

shots.section_title: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
shots.scene: 两个对话气泡交换灯泡
shots.prompt_en: Two speech bubbles exchanging a light bulb back and forth. No people.
shots.narration: 这离不开思想交流，也要尊重别人发言。

shots.section_title: 大学需要交流，表达要负责
shots.scene: 一个对话气泡里有交通指示牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble containing a road direction sign icon pointing to a building. No people.
shots.narration: 有意见，走学校的正当渠道反映。

shots.section_title: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
shots.scene: 教室、实验室、会议室图标被一条警戒线围着保护
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a classroom, a laboratory, and a meeting room protected by a ring of safety tape. No people.
shots.narration: 任何集体活动，都不能打断教学科研。
overlay: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人

shots.section_title: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
shots.scene: 推搡和堵门两个图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: pushing people, and blocking a doorway. No people.
shots.narration: 不推搡、不堵门，不能危及别人安全。

shots.section_title: 不扰乱教学科研，不危及他人
shots.scene: 空白处分决定书
shots.prompt_en: A blank disciplinary notice on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 扰乱正常秩序，要受处分。

shots.scene: 老周站在活动现场边上，微笑着和学生交谈
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the side of a campus event and talks kindly with students.
shots.narration: 活动现场，会有老师陪同。

shots.scene: 老周递给阿杰一瓶水
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a bottle of water to the young male student at an outdoor event.
shots.narration: 老师在场是帮忙，不是来挑错。

shots.scene: 户外场地和音量图标
shots.prompt_en: An outdoor lawn icon with a speaker and a volume bar turned down. No people.
shots.narration: 户外活动，按学校户外活动规定办。

shots.scene: 室内大厅图标，人数计数器指向上限
shots.prompt_en: An indoor hall icon with a people counter needle pointing to a red limit mark. No people.
shots.narration: 室内活动，人数不能超过场地容量。

shots.section_title: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
shots.scene: 学生举着空白小牌子站在走廊一边
shots.prompt_en: Students hold small blank signs and stand along one side of a wide corridor, leaving the path clear.
shots.narration: 举牌、横幅可以有，但别挡路。
overlay: 标语器材要安全，按时离场

shots.section_title: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
shots.scene: 过长的杆子横幅挡住通道的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a long banner pole blocking a corridor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 伤人或碍事的，要换地方或撤掉。

shots.section_title: 标语器材要安全，按时离场
shots.scene: 时钟指向闭馆时间，门口的人有序离开
shots.prompt_en: A wall clock beside a building door at closing time; students walk out in an orderly line.
shots.narration: 楼宇到点关门，就要按时离场。

shots.scene: 阿杰和老周一起看空白校园地图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the older man look at a blank campus map together.
shots.narration: 办集体活动，先找指导老师商量。

shots.scene: 地图上一个地点被圈出，一条路线箭头连到另一栋楼
shots.prompt_en: A blank campus map with one place circled and a route arrow to another building. No people.
shots.narration: 在哪办、要去哪，申请里都写清楚。

shots.scene: 日历上活动日之前几格被标记
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar with the days before an event day highlighted and a submit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 申请要提前交，批准了才能办。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师站在活动现场
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator stand together at the edge of a campus event.
shots.narration: 老师在现场，帮活动顺利、安全。

shots.scene: 校门外的马路图标和一个空白许可文件
shots.prompt_en: A road outside a campus gate icon with a blank permit document. No people.
shots.narration: 走出校门上马路，须依法办理许可。

shots.scene: 红绿灯图标，绿灯亮
shots.prompt_en: A traffic light icon showing green, beside a small crowd icon. No people.
shots.narration: 活动秩序正常，就可以继续。

shots.scene: 红绿灯变红，旁边是教室和实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: The traffic light turns red, next to classroom and laboratory icons. No people.
shots.narration: 干扰教学科研、侵犯他人，学校会叫停。

shots.scene: 空白规章本叠在一起
shots.prompt_en: Several blank rule books stacked together. No people.
shots.narration: 其他校规照样适用，严重的要担法律责任。

shots.section_title: 不同观点分区，配合查验
shots.scene: 场地平面图分成两块区域，中间有通道
shots.prompt_en: A blank floor plan divided into two separate zones with an aisle between them. No people.
shots.narration: 观点不同的两方，分开区域。
overlay: 不同观点分区，配合查验

shots.section_title: 不同观点分区，配合查验
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员站在活动现场边
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands calmly at the edge of a campus event.
shots.narration: 保卫人员可以到场维持秩序。

shots.section_title: 不同观点分区，配合查验
shots.scene: 学生向保卫处值班员出示空白学生证
shots.prompt_en: A student shows a blank student ID card to the security officer.
shots.narration: 工作人员要求时，主动出示证件。

shots.scene: 酒杯和法槌图标
shots.prompt_en: A wine glass icon next to a judge's gavel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 喝酒这件事，有法律底线。

shots.scene: 酒瓶递给一个儿童小人的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle being handed to a small child figure, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不许向未成年人提供酒。

shots.scene: 欣欣摆手拒绝一杯酒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot politely pushes away a glass of beer with its paw.
shots.narration: 社团活动，最好不喝酒。

shots.scene: 空白申请表和日历
shots.prompt_en: A blank application form next to a calendar with an early date circled. No people.
shots.narration: 确需供酒，要按学校规定提前申请。

shots.scene: 老周在空白表格上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank form at a desk.
shots.narration: 指导老师审核批准，才能办。

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 两个人形图标戴着袖标，站在活动桌旁
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons wearing armbands standing by an event table. No people.
shots.narration: 要有学生和老师负责人全程在场。
overlay: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 烈酒瓶打红叉，旁边一个小酒杯和限量刻度
shots.prompt_en: A strong liquor bottle crossed out with a red X; beside it a small glass with a limit gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 不上烈酒，总量和每人量都要限制。

shots.section_title: 供酒规则：有人管、有限量
shots.scene: 王老师在门口查看空白证件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank ID card at an event entrance.
shots.narration: 有人未成年时，由老师查证件、管供应。

shots.scene: 未成年人图标被一道屏障挡在酒桌外
shots.prompt_en: A minor figure icon kept away from a drinks table by a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 确保未成年人碰不到酒。

shots.scene: 果汁、矿泉水、面包、水果图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of juice, bottled water, bread and fruit on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 备足不含酒的饮料和食物。

shots.scene: 自带酒瓶和带酒杯的海报，均打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a bottle brought from outside, and a poster with a wine glass on it. No people.
shots.narration: 不准自带酒，宣传里不提酒。

shots.scene: 时钟显示活动快结束，酒杯被收起
shots.prompt_en: A clock near the end of an event; glasses are being cleared away. No people.
shots.narration: 活动快结束前，停止供酒。

shots.scene: 阿杰背着书包，书本放在旅行包上面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with a backpack, a stack of books placed on top of a travel bag.
shots.narration: 社团出行，要符合社团宗旨，不误学业。

shots.scene: 空白登记表提前提交，日历上标出期限
shots.prompt_en: A blank travel registration form being submitted early, with a deadline marked on a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 提前提交出行登记。

shots.scene: 老周在空白登记表上盖章
shots.prompt_en: The older man stamps a blank travel form with approval.
shots.narration: 指导老师批准了，才能出发。

shots.scene: 空白名单，每行都有电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank roster with a phone icon on each line. No people.
shots.narration: 交上全体出行人员名单和手机号。

shots.scene: 私家车、租赁车、校车三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three car icons: a private car, a rental car, and a school vehicle. No people.
shots.narration: 开什么车，都要守学校的用车规定。

shots.scene: 未经批准的出行箭头被红叉划掉，旁边一个空钱袋
shots.prompt_en: A travel arrow crossed out with a red X, beside an empty money bag. No people.
shots.narration: 私自出行要受处分，费用也不报。

shots.scene: 驾照图标、日历和里程表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank driver license card, a calendar, and an odometer. No people.
shots.narration: 开车的人，年龄、驾龄、经验都要够。

shots.scene: 干净的空白记录单打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean blank driving record sheet with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 没有交通违法记录，每年重新审核。

shots.section_title: 驾驶审批材料要提前交
shots.scene: 一叠空白表格和驾照复印件放进文件袋
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank forms and a copy of a blank license going into a folder. No people.
shots.narration: 用车确认、授权表、驾照复印件要交齐。
overlay: 驾驶审批材料要提前交

shots.section_title: 驾驶审批材料要提前交
shots.scene: 私家车图标旁多了检查单和保险单
shots.prompt_en: A private car icon with an extra blank inspection checklist and insurance card beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 开私家车，还要车检和保险证明。

shots.section_title: 罚单自己担，保险看手续
shots.scene: 罚单图标落在司机图标手里
shots.prompt_en: A blank ticket icon landing in the hand of a driver icon. No people.
shots.narration: 罚单由开车的人自己负责。
overlay: 罚单自己担，保险看手续

shots.section_title: 罚单自己担，保险看手续
shots.scene: 盾牌罩住租赁车，旁边一叠打勾的表格
shots.prompt_en: A shield covering a rental car icon, beside a stack of blank forms with check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 手续齐全，才在学校保险范围内。

shots.scene: 车内乘客都系好安全带
shots.prompt_en: Inside a car, the young male student and the female graduate student fasten their seat belts.
shots.narration: 全车人员，全程系好安全带。

shots.scene: 酒杯和药丸挡在方向盘前，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A wine glass and a pill in front of a steering wheel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不酒驾，不毒驾，驾照随身带。

shots.scene: 雨、雾、雪、冰四个天气图标，旁边一个停着的车
shots.prompt_en: Four weather icons: heavy rain, fog, snow and ice, beside a parked car. No people.
shots.narration: 恶劣天气，别冒险上路。

shots.scene: 刹车、车灯、方向盘图标带问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of brakes, headlights and a steering wheel, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 车况有毛病，修好再开。

shots.scene: 陌生人搭车的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stranger hitchhiking at the roadside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不顺路捎带与活动无关的人。

shots.scene: 司机手机、调音响、吃东西三个图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a phone in a driver's hand, adjusting a radio, and eating while driving. No people.
shots.narration: 开车不看手机、不调音响、不吃喝。

shots.scene: 音量条很低，旁边喇叭图标
shots.prompt_en: A low volume bar next to a car horn icon with sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 音乐声要小，能听见喇叭。

shots.scene: 长长的公路和一个打哈欠的司机图标
shots.prompt_en: A long highway icon and a yawning driver icon with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 长途出行，最怕疲劳驾驶。

shots.scene: 服务区停车休息、司机换人的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a car parked at a rest area and two drivers swapping seats. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定停车休息，轮换驾驶。

shots.scene: 副驾驶上的小研清醒地看着前方
shots.prompt_en: Inside a car, the female graduate student sits awake in the passenger seat, watching the road.
shots.narration: 副驾驶要有人醒着，陪司机。

shots.scene: 月亮和星星下的公路，汽车图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A highway under the moon and stars, with a car icon crossed out by a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 半夜到凌晨，不安排开车。

shots.scene: 电话图标连到学院楼和老师图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon connected by lines to a college building icon and a teacher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事故，马上报告带队老师和学校。

shots.scene: 手机屏幕上显示数字 110 120 122
shots.prompt_en: A phone screen showing a large dial pad. No people.

shots.scene: 空白罚单交到老师手里
shots.prompt_en: A blank traffic ticket handed to a teacher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 收到交通罚单，也要报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰深呼吸，表情冷静
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a deep breath and stays calm beside a parked car at the roadside.
shots.narration: 先冷静，对人有礼貌。

shots.scene: 车辆停到路边，钥匙图标熄火
shots.prompt_en: A car moved to the road shoulder and a key icon turning the engine off. No people.
shots.narration: 能移车就安全靠边，熄火。

shots.scene: 空白笔记本上画着车辆、车牌、人名图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook with sketches of a car, a blank license plate and a name tag. No people.
shots.narration: 记下对方信息、车辆和车牌。

shots.scene: 阿杰向交警说明情况
shots.prompt_en: The young male student explains calmly to a traffic police officer at the roadside.
shots.narration: 如实向警察说明，不急着争对错。

shots.scene: 手机上发帖的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of posting on social media from a phone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 事故细节，不在网上随便发。

shots.scene: 不同肤色、性别、年龄的人形图标手拉手
shots.prompt_en: Icons of diverse people of different ages and genders holding hands in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 校园里不能有歧视和骚扰。

shots.scene: 骚扰、跟踪、暴力三个图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: an unwanted touching hand, a shadow following a person, and a raised fist. No people.
shots.narration: 性骚扰、跟踪、暴力，都被禁止。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白展板前，展板上只有一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a blank display board with only a shield icon.
shots.narration: 这部分还会有专门的培训。

shots.scene: 四个图标：盾牌、医院十字、心形、电话
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a shield, a medical cross, a heart, and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 保卫处、校医院、心理中心都能求助。

shots.scene: 小研把求助电话存进手机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student saves contact numbers into her phone.
shots.narration: 把求助电话，提前存进手机。

shots.scene: 空白测验卷和一支笔
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz sheet and a pencil on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 学完做个小测验，再进入下一课。

shots.scene: 手机屏幕上的群聊气泡里有哭脸和打叉的照片图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone screen with group chat bubbles, a crying face icon and a crossed-out photo icon. No people.
shots.narration: 群里羞辱人、恶意P图，也是欺凌。

shots.scene: 手机截图图标和一个保存按钮
shots.prompt_en: A screenshot icon and a save button on a phone screen. No people.
shots.narration: 截图留证，及时报告老师。

shots.scene: 隐私照片外传的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a private photo being forwarded, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别转发、别围观、别曝光他人隐私。

shots.scene: 一个人趴在桌上，旁边一杯酒
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps over a table next to a glass, looking very drunk, at a restaurant.
shots.narration: 有人喝醉了，不能让他一个人待着。

shots.scene: 侧卧姿势示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a person lying on their side in the recovery position. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 让他侧躺，防止呕吐物堵住气道。

shots.scene: 叫不醒、呼吸慢、发冷三个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: a person who cannot be woken, slow breathing, and cold skin. No people.
shots.narration: 叫不醒、呼吸异常，马上拨打120。

shots.scene: 劝酒的手势，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand pushing a drink at someone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不劝酒，不拼酒，更不用酒“考验”人。

shots.scene: 楼梯口人群拥挤的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a crowd squeezing at the top of a stairway, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人多的地方，最怕拥挤踩踏。

shots.scene: 安全出口标志和畅通的通道
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign above a clear, unblocked corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 办活动前，先看好安全出口和通道。

shots.scene: 学生们靠右有序通行，保卫处值班员引导
shots.prompt_en: Students walk in an orderly line on the right side of a corridor, guided by the security officer.
shots.narration: 有序进出，不推不挤，听从指挥。

shots.scene: 一个人被挤倒时双手护头蜷身的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a person curled up protecting the head with both arms. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 万一被挤倒，双手护头，蜷身侧卧。

shots.scene: 一辆正规大巴停在校门口，旁边空白合同
shots.prompt_en: A clean coach bus parked at a campus gate, with a blank contract beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 集体出行，选正规客运车辆。

shots.scene: 超载的小车图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An overloaded small car icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不超载，不坐来路不明的车。

shots.scene: 保险单图标和打勾的名单
shots.prompt_en: A blank insurance card icon next to a checked roster. No people.
shots.narration: 买好保险，集体行动，按时报平安。

shots.scene: 停在路边的车开着双闪
shots.prompt_en: A car parked on the road shoulder with its hazard lights flashing. No people.
shots.narration: 车停下后，先打开危险报警闪光灯。

shots.scene: 车后方远处放着三角警告牌
shots.prompt_en: A red warning triangle placed on the road far behind a stopped car. No people.
shots.narration: 在来车方向放好警告标志。

shots.scene: 车上的人撤到护栏外的安全处
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student stand safely behind a roadside guardrail.
shots.narration: 人员撤到护栏外，别站在车道上。

shots.scene: 有人受伤，先打120的图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone dialing icon next to a medical cross. No people.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，先救人，拨打120。

shots.scene: 小研抬手做出“停”的手势
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand firmly in a stop gesture.
shots.narration: 遇到骚扰，明确说“不”。

shots.scene: 手机截图、聊天记录、日历三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a phone screenshot, a chat record, and a calendar date. No people.
shots.narration: 保存聊天记录等证据。

shots.scene: 小研走进辅导员办公室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks into a counselor's office where the safety administrator welcomes her.
shots.narration: 告诉辅导员、学校或报警110。

shots.scene: 一群人中有人上前站在受害者身边
shots.prompt_en: A bystander steps forward to stand beside someone being bothered. Simple cartoon figures.
shots.narration: 看到别人被骚扰，帮一把、去报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰独自坐在宿舍窗前，头顶一朵小乌云
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits alone by a dorm window with a small gray cloud above his head.
shots.narration: 压力大、心里难受，别一个人扛。

shots.scene: 心形图标和对话气泡
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon and a speech bubble with a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 找学校心理中心，或者信任的人。

shots.scene: 小研拍拍阿杰的肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently pats the young male student on the shoulder.
shots.narration: 发现同学不对劲，及时告诉老师。

shots.section_title: 社团借用实验室，先准入
shots.scene: 科技社团学生站在实验室门口，门上有安全标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a laboratory door with a blank safety notice board.
shots.narration: 科技社团借实验室，先参加安全培训。
overlay: 社团借用实验室，先准入

shots.section_title: 社团借用实验室，先准入
shots.scene: 老周在实验室里陪同，学生戴好护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Inside a lab, the older man supervises while students wear safety goggles and lab coats.
shots.narration: 要有老师在场，守实验室规定。

shots.section_title: 社团借用实验室，先准入
shots.scene: 烟花和化学瓶带出实验室的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of fireworks and a chemical bottle being carried out of a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 活动不玩火，不私带化学品。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上有四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with four icons: a raised palm, a crowd, a wine glass, and a car.
shots.narration: 最后，记住四句话。

shots.scene: 举起的手掌图标
shots.prompt_en: A raised open palm icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 拒绝欺凌，“自愿”也不行。

shots.scene: 人群和安全出口图标
shots.prompt_en: A crowd icon next to an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 集体活动先审批，守秩序、防踩踏。

shots.scene: 酒杯打叉和汽车安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: A wine glass crossed out with a red X next to a seat belt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 活动少喝酒，出行守规矩。

shots.scene: 电话和心形图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon and a heart icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 遇事及时报告，有困难就求助。

shots.scene: 阿杰把空白计划板上的酒杯和深夜月亮擦掉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student erases the beer mug and night moon doodles from the planning board and smiles.
shots.narration: 阿杰改了迎新方案，大家玩得放心。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在社团招新摊位前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student and the female graduate student in front of a club booth.
shots.narration: 安全办活动，社团才长久。下次见！
